verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents raw transaction retrieval (up to 24 months), balances, identity and auth. Nothing describes recurring-stream detection, payroll detection, or an income-verification product. Raw transaction data is only a building block a developer could use to derive income signals, so it earns no credit. Deriving income and cash-flow signals is a fair axis for a financial-data platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform derives income and cash-flow signals from connected accounts — recurring streams, payroll detection, or documented income verification products built on the same data
